proposal.reason: Primary change is contribution/review automation: new `/merge` command flow, squash-message generation/publishing, reviewer-routing CLI sharing, and policy updates in skills/templates/contributing docs. The `pr-test-ppu.yml` edits are supporting workflow wiring (triggers/concurrency/conditional gating) to enable message-only and merge paths while preserving normal test execution behavior, so no separate `ci` module is independently substantive.
